title: SKAB run valve2/2
note: Real data from the SKAB pump rig. The shaded band is the fault labelled by SKAB.

alerts.title: Motor temperature falling unusually fast, not yet confirmed
reasons: Only motor temperature moved; no related signal confirms it yet.
A real fault and a sensor offset look the same at this point.
alerts.cause: Change in heat balance: cooling, friction or fluid temperature. Could also be a sensor offset.
alerts.action: Check the motor temperature reading against a local gauge (a two-minute check). If it agrees, treat this as a machine fault.
alerts.truth: No labelled fault here: this alarm counts as a false alarm in our metrics.

alerts.title: Vibration B rose 3.6σ, not yet confirmed
reasons: Only vibration B moved; no related signal confirms it yet.
A real fault and a sensor offset look the same at this point.
alerts.cause: Mechanical change at the pump: imbalance, looseness or cavitation. Could also be a sensor offset.
alerts.action: Check the vibration b reading against a local gauge (a two-minute check). If it agrees, treat this as a machine fault.
alerts.truth: Overlaps a fault labelled in SKAB.

alerts.title: Flow rate fell 7.5σ, confirmed by vibration A
reasons: 2 signals are outside their limits at the same time, which a single faulty sensor cannot cause.
alerts.cause: Restriction or leak in the pump loop, for example a partly closed or sticking valve.
alerts.action: Inspect the valves and pipework on the pump loop on pump P-101 this shift. Assembly and Packing depend on this station.
alerts.truth: Overlaps a fault labelled in SKAB.
